overview: This Senate resolution honors the 67 people killed on January 29, 2025, when American Airlines Flight 5342 and an Army aviation unit's helicopter (Priority Air Transport 25) collided near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport. The victims included passengers, airline crew, and service members from many states and several other countries. The resolution offers condolences to their families and thanks the dozens of local, state, and federal police, fire, rescue, and military teams that responded in harsh conditions. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on February 6, 2025.
for: Supporters say the Senate should formally mourn one of the deadliest U.S. air disasters in years and recognize the first responders who carried out the rescue and recovery.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not itself address aviation safety or change any law or spending.
